literal_case_input: Investigar el incidente WEB-001 de CAPTURA_WEB: durante ACT-0058, 7 URL de Reevalúa devolvieron Cache miss al usar web.run open(url). El pipeline marcó FALLIDO sin generar conocimiento inventado. Diagnosticar control raíz, política de reintentos, consumidor de reingreso y autoridad de propietario. Preservar fail-closed, no escribir datos ni inferir owner sin fuente vigente. Registrar consultas deterministas N1 y N2, continuar búsqueda relevante si faltan datos, y distinguir hecho, hipótesis, reparación y evidencia pendiente.

n1_asset.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,codigo_activo,nombre_canonico,owner_name,estado_operativo FROM public.v_lf_fuente_operativa_busqueda WHERE codigo_activo='ACT-0058'

n2_asset.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,codigo_activo,nombre_canonico,owner_name,estado_operativo FROM public.lf_activos WHERE codigo_activo='ACT-0058'

n1_policy.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,operation_code,policy_code,policy_version,policy_sha FROM public.v_lf_operation_policy_snapshot WHERE operation_code='ORQUESTACION_PIPELINE_LF' ORDER BY policy_code

n2_owner_policy.query: WITH zero AS (SELECT policy_code,policy_version,policy_sha,status FROM public.lf_policy_versions WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND (policy_code ILIKE '%OWNER%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%ASSET%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%CUSTOD%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%SUPER%')) SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,count(*) AS row_count,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(zero)) FILTER (WHERE zero.policy_code IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM zero

retry_contract.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,step_id,step_order,pass_condition,block_condition,execution_sql FROM public.lf_operation_step_contracts WHERE operation_code='ORQUESTACION_PIPELINE_LF' AND step_id='failed_retry'

rows.pass_condition: retry_count <= 3; error registrado y pipeline en cola de reintento
rows.execution_sql:
UPDATE public.lf_pipeline_runs
SET retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    error_detail = :error_type || ': ' || :error_detail,
    stage_status = CASE
      WHEN retry_count + 1 >= 3 THEN 'FAILED'
      WHEN :error_type IN ('SCHEMA_ERROR', 'FK_VIOLATION') THEN 'FAILED'
      ELSE 'PENDING'
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE pipeline_run_id = :pipeline_run_id
RETURNING pipeline_run_id, retry_count, stage_status, error_detail;

ekb.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,codigo,categoria,descripcion,prevencion,frecuencia,estado FROM public.lf_error_knowledge WHERE codigo='WEB-001'

rows.descripcion: Durante ACT-0058, 7 URLs de Reevalúa devolvieron Cache miss al ejecutar web.run open(url). El pipeline las cerró fail-closed como FALLIDO sin inventar contenido.
rows.prevencion: No crear captura, homologación, decisión ni KB si el fetch falla. Registrar FALLIDO con error_detail, conservar trazabilidad y permitir reintento posterior controlado.
